deferral.reason: live-device CPU, battery, thermal, route, interruption, background, release-bundle decode, Ogg, AVAudioSourceNode timing, stem timing, and memory-pressure proof is absent

blockers.requiredProof: physical iOS and signed macOS CPU captures with render p95/p99 and underrun counters
battery drain and thermal-state captures during sustained foreground playback
screen-off, lock-screen, background, and foreground-resume playback behavior
speaker, wired headphone, Bluetooth, AirPlay if supported, sample-rate, and buffer-size route transitions
call, Siri, alarm, ducking, and media-services-reset interruption/resume behavior
TestFlight/App Store-style iOS and signed macOS bundle asset decode/register proof
every committed piano and soundscape Ogg/Vorbis asset decodes through native AVAudioFile on target OS/device combinations
AVAudioSourceNode master callback timing under live hardware IO
master and stem taps remain sample-aligned under live-device playback and recording
decoded asset cache behavior under memory pressure, warnings, eviction, and re-registration

releaseGatePolicy: core:product:native-release may pass with deferred blockers; native default release approval remains blocked until signed-off live-device and release-bundle evidence exists
